Baseline_1_StraightLine.notes: Direct straight line ignores rocks; collides with obstacles.

Baseline_2_Grid_AStar.notes: Avoids discrete obstacles but ignores slope gradients and turning radius.

Baseline_3_Terrain_AStar.notes: Avoids steep cells but produces discontinuous grid paths infeasible for nonholonomic rovers.

Proposed_Kinodynamic_Hybrid_AStar.notes: Full kinodynamic curvature compliance (rho >= 0.67m), swept footprint clearance, smooth tracking.
